content: तम A Taddhita affix of the superlative degree applied to nouns, adjectives and also to verbs and indeclinables in which latter case it is changed to तमाम्; अश्व˚ <ls>Pt. 5</ls> ‘the best horse’; सुहृत्तम <ls>Mu. 1</ls>; so पचतितमाम्. It is also added to pronouns in the sense of ‘one of many’ {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} कतम, यतम, ततम <ab>&c.</ab>
